t: Ecosurety | FPF FlexCollect - the UK’s biggest flexible plastic household collection and recycling pilot goes live
s: The £2.9m Flexible Plastic Fund FlexCollect project is the most extensive pilot for household collection and recycling of flexible plastic packaging ever undertaken in the UK.

With the FPF FlexCollect project, we are trialing a series of innovative flexible plastic household collection and recycling pilots between 2022 and 2025. The project will help to understand how to incorporate flexibles into existing collection services across different geographies and demographics and develop best practice ahead of the introduction of consistent collections across the UK in 2027.

t: FPF FlexCollect Report: Insights and the future of flexible plastic recycling | WRAP - The Waste and Resources Action Programme
s: Join the UK’s leading ‘Flexperts’ from Ecosurety, SUEZ, Recoup and WRAP for a webinar unpacking the key findings of the FPF FlexCollect project.
